title: 7.16.4 Lab: Two fighters
description: Fill in the Fighter class's draw(x, y): a body, a name and an hp bar scaled by hp / maxHp. The hero and the goblin are already made; each one draws itself.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The top says `Hero vs Goblin`: both fighters are made, in `newGame()`, and each has a name. But the class's `draw(x, y)` method is empty and nothing calls it, so nothing else shows.

steps.title: A body and a name
steps.instructions: Inside the class's `draw(x, y)` method, draw the body: `fill(this.isAlive() ? this.color : '#555');` and `circle(x, y, 70);`, then the name under it: `text(this.name, x - 40, y + 60, 16, 'white');`. In the sketch's `draw()`, after `background(...)`, draw both fighters: `fighters[0].draw(130, 150);` and `fighters[1].draw(350, 150);`. Run: a gold hero on the left and an orange goblin on the right.
hints: There are two things called draw: the sketch's `function draw()`, which runs every frame, and the class's `draw(x, y)` method, which draws one fighter. The method's lines go inside the class.
`fighters[0]` is you and `fighters[1]` the one you face.

steps.title: The hp bar
steps.instructions: In the method, below the name, the grey bar: `fill('#333');` and `rect(x - 60, y + 70, 120, 10);`. On top of it, the full part, green or red: `fill(this.hp > this.maxHp / 3 ? 'limegreen' : 'tomato');` and `rect(x - 60, y + 70, 120 * this.hp / this.maxHp, 10);`. Last, the numbers: `text(this.hp + '/' + this.maxHp, x - 60, y + 98, 12, '#ccc');`. Run: two full green bars, 30/30 and 24/24.
hints: `this.hp / this.maxHp` is a share from 0 to 1, so the full part is never wider than the grey bar.
`x - 60` starts a 120-pixel bar 60 pixels left of the centre, so it sits right under the circle.

steps.title: Try a hurt goblin
steps.instructions: To see the bar work, in `newGame()`, on the line below `fighters = [...]`, add `fighters[1].hp = 6;` and Run: the goblin's bar is a quarter full, red, and says 6/24. Change it to `0`: the goblin turns grey and its bar is empty. Then delete the line, so the fight starts at full health.
hints: 6 out of 24 is a quarter, and a quarter is less than a third, so the bar turns red.

requirements.description: The Fighter class has a method that draws the fighter with circle or rect. Help: 7.16.2 (Reading: One class, many fighters)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Lab: Two fighters". The task: fill in the Fighter class's draw(x, y) method so a fighter draws itself: a circle in its colour (grey once it is not alive), its name, and an hp bar made of a grey rect 120 wide with a rect on top that is 120 * this.hp / this.maxHp wide; then draw fighters[0] and fighters[1] from draw(). Accept any names, helpers, ternaries, nested ifs, switch statements and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.
